title: NexusCommerce — System Overview
description: Centralized monitoring: system resources, concurrency, performance, database, message broker & queues

links.title: Logs & Traces
links.tooltip: Loki logs, Tempo traces, service map

panels.title: System health
panels.description: HEALTHY: every service and dependency passes. DEGRADED: a non-critical dependency fails (Redis, Kafka, MinIO — the system still serves). CRITICAL: a service /health or PostgreSQL is down.

panels.title: API throughput
panels.description: Completed API requests per second (selected service / endpoints / methods)

panels.title: API error rate
panels.description: 5xx share of API requests

panels.title: Apdex (T = 250 ms)
panels.description: User satisfaction 0–1: requests ≤ 250 ms count fully, ≤ 1 s count half, slower count zero

panels.title: Latency p95 by endpoint
panels.description: Top 10 slowest endpoints

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$api_service",route=~"/api/.+",route=~"$endpoint",method=~"$method"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Throughput by endpoint
panels.description: Top 10 busiest endpoints

panels.title: API latency distribution
panels.description: How many requests fell into each latency bucket over time — spot slow outliers the averages hide

panels.title: API endpoint scorecard
panels.description: Latency and throughput per endpoint (last 5 minutes; 'Requests (range)' covers the dashboard time range). Click a header to sort.

targets.expr: sum by (service, method, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum{service=~"$api_service",route=~"/api/.+",route=~"$endpoint",method=~"$method"}[5m])) / sum by (service, method, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{service=~"$api_service",route=~"/api/.+",route=~"$endpoint",method=~"$method"}[5m]))
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, service, method, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$api_service",route=~"/api/.+",route=~"$endpoint",method=~"$method"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service, method, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$api_service",route=~"/api/.+",route=~"$endpoint",method=~"$method"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, service, method, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$api_service",route=~"/api/.+",route=~"$endpoint",method=~"$method"}[5m])))

100 * (sum by (service, method, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{service=~"$api_service",route=~"/api/.+",route=~"$endpoint",method=~"$method",status=~"5.."}[5m])) or sum by (service, method, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{service=~"$api_service",route=~"/api/.+",route=~"$endpoint",method=~"$method"}[5m])) * 0) / sum by (service, method, route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{service=~"$api_service",route=~"/api/.+",route=~"$endpoint",method=~"$method"}[5m]))
